name: linux-runner-surfaces-real-exit-code
description: The runner must surface lbabus's real process exit code — never a shell/pipe-masked 0 (the classic `lbabus wait | tail` hazard where $? is tail's, not lbabus's). An unknown subcommand exits 1 with a diagnostic on stderr; the runner must observe exactly exit 1 AND the diagnostic, proving it reads the child's real ExitCode with no pipe in the path. Fully offline: no network, no mock, no ripgrep.
